units.raw_text: A deterministic repository standard that keeps humans and AI coding agents aligned through canonical documentation, binding CI constraints, multi-identity code review, and automated external review via the OpenAI Codex GitHub App. Mergepath is the enforcement layer underneath every other project on this site — the reason "built with AI agents" comes with a governance trail instead of just a vibe. Currently deployed across seven repositories.
